purpose: Navigate between labelled anchors within a long form or bounded workspace without owning section state.
useWhen: long forms or workspaces need page-local anchor navigation
a global shell already owns route navigation
avoidWhen: switching between peer content panels; use Tabs
route-level navigation; use Sidebar, TopNavigation, or NavigationMenu
accessibility: Expose a named nav landmark and aria-current=location for the active anchor.
Keep native anchor and summary keyboard behavior; the consumer may supply scroll-spy state through activeId.
responsive: Render the labelled anchor list on wide layouts.
Collapse to a native details summary and compact anchor menu on narrow layouts without changing item semantics.
motion: Uses the shared transition and easing variables for mobile disclosure.
